item.title: Ask HN: When you search for jobs do you prefer a generalist or a niche job board
item.summary: When you search for a job do you prefer a generalist or a niche job board? I mean, do you go to indeed or linkedin, or you go to what ever specific job site in your niche? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49426344 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
